notes.title: Party
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43611489/aa4c5d381a79b16cb39bddf985375a23a925a940.png

Greetings to you, my follower ;)

There are already 60 of you and that's great! Where would you like to gossip with me about the development progress, ask questions, try out the Alpha version of the game? I have a Discord channel, or better yet, I can host a meetup in Steam.

And I'm also having trouble publishing content on platforms like facebook, twitter (xcom) etc.

I'm waiting for your suggestions to establish a relationship between me and you.
